verdict.rationale: Source openness is a fair question for a chip, since open hardware designs and open-source chip toolchains exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Apple M5's own design or firmware source is readable under an open license. MLX being described as open-source is a separate developer framework, an adjacent building block that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
